Indefinite and Unjustified Limitation of Available Outdoor Recreation Resources Pending Completion of Classification - BLM, as noted above, is responsible for the management of over 452 million acres of public land which land is widely dispersed and of highly diverse characteristics. Given existing staff resources, it would be expected that the envisaged classification of all BLM lands into that which is open for use and that which is closed to use will be a project of at least several years in duration. Since no significant amount of public lands has yet been classified as opened to ORRV use, the effect of the proposed sudden reversal in policy will be to close all BLM lands to ORRV use until the above-referenced classification scheme is completed. Thus, the proposed scheme of regulation would presume that ORRV use - a beneficial recreational activity - is environmentally objectionable until the contrary is proven. It is submitted that such policy is not reasonably calculated to promote and develop recreational resources for the American people.
